about: The one ffmpeg build the macOS app ships (ADR-0003, amendment of 2026-10-09: plain GPL, pinned by checksum). Fetched by scripts/fetch-ffmpeg-mac.mjs, checked again by scripts/electron-builder-before-pack.cjs. To move to a newer build: download it, run `ffmpeg -buildconf` (no --enable-nonfree), then change every field below (contentSha256 with scripts/verify-mac-package.mjs --content-hash <binary>) together with resources/ffmpeg-mac/FFMPEG-NOTICE.md and scripts/lib/ffmpeg-mac-source-manifest.json (the corresponding source).
contentSha256About: SHA-256 of the binary with its code signature removed (codesign --remove-signature) and the __LINKEDIT segment's vmsize set to zero (scripts/lib/ffmpeg-ship-check.cjs, machoContentSha256): the same for the published binary and for any re-signed copy of it, so scripts/verify-mac-package.mjs can identify the pinned program inside a signed app. Measured 2026-10-09 on the published binary, an ad-hoc re-signed copy and a hardened-runtime re-signed copy.

source.buildScriptRevisionEvidence: no build log names it; it is the head of the develop branch when this build was made (commit 18:00 CEST, build 21:18 CEST on 2026-09-20; next commit 2026-09-24), and every library version in its version/ folder equals versions.txt below. Details in ffmpeg-mac-source-manifest.json.
source.correspondingSource: scripts/lib/ffmpeg-mac-source-manifest.json; packed by scripts/build-ffmpeg-source-bundle.mjs and attached to every GitHub release that ships this binary as TalkWeaver-<version>-ffmpeg-9.0.2-corresponding-source.tar

verified: 2026-10-09: downloaded; archive and binary hashes computed locally, archive hash equal to the published ffmpeg.zip.sha256; ffmpeg -buildconf shows --enable-gpl --enable-version3 and no --enable-nonfree; links only macOS system libraries
